author: Gould, 1845
status: 여름철새 수만 마리 · 나그네새 수천 마리
summary: 우리나라에는 흔하지 않은 여름철새로, 산림에 산다. 탁란하는 새로, 산솔새, 쇠솔새, 숲새, 동박새, 흰눈썹황금새, 큰유리새, 삼광조 등의 둥지에 알을 낳는다. ‘보보 보보’ 하는 2음절 소리를 되풀이한다. 국외에서는 유럽 동부에서 러시아, 중국 동부와 남부, 일본에 걸쳐 번식하고 중국 남부와 동남아시아에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: belly bars slightly broader than Common Cuckoo's

sexes.male: 머리와 윗면, 멱과 윗가슴이 짙은 회색이고 흰 배에 굵은 검은 가로줄이 있다.
sexes.female: 수컷과 비슷하나 목과 윗가슴에 적갈색 기가 돈다. 온몸이 적갈색 바탕에 검은 가로줄이 있는 적색형 암컷도 있다.

young: 어린새는 윗면이 검은 갈색이고 깃 가장자리가 넓게 희며, 멱과 가슴도 거무스름하다. 적색형 어린새는 적색형 암컷과 비슷하나 머리와 멱까지 촘촘한 가로줄이 있다.

similar.how: 비슷하지만 벙어리뻐꾸기는 배의 줄무늬가 조금 더 굵다.

art.subject: Oriental Cuckoo (Cuculus optatus), adult male, as seen in Korean forests from May to August: head, upperparts, throat and upper breast slate-grey, slightly darker than in Common Cuckoo; lower breast, belly and flanks white, often tinged buff towards the vent, with broad, widely spaced blackish bars; tail long and graduated, blackish with small white spots and white tips. Bill dark grey with a yellow base. Yellow iris with a yellow eye-ring. Short yellow legs.
art.pose: perched on a forest branch, calling
art.scene: Korean summer forest with a leafy canopy; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a forest branch: slate-grey head, upperparts and upper breast, broad blackish bars on the white belly, yellow eye-ring, long graduated tail with white spots
adult, head detail in profile: yellow iris with a yellow eye-ring, dark grey bill with a yellow base
art.build: Slim, long-tailed cuckoo, about 33cm, about the length of a feral pigeon but much slimmer, the same shape as Common Cuckoo: small head, short slightly decurved bill, long pointed wings drooped at rest below the tail base, long graduated tail. Legs very short, yellow, two toes forward and two back. Flight hawk-like with shallow wingbeats. Visually told from Common Cuckoo mainly by the broader, more widely spaced belly bars and slightly darker grey upperparts.
avoid: Do not paint a red iris; the eye is yellow.
Do not paint thin, fine bars like Common Cuckoo's; the bars are broader and fewer.
Do not paint a hooked raptor bill or strong talons.
